text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning sex was almost certainly not a factor in choosing between you. While an all-male panel may reflect a lack of organizational diversity or potentially breach internal civil service guidelines on panel composition, it does not demonstrate unlawful sex discrimination against you. 

Raising gender bias in this context would appear unfounded and could damage your professional standing within the civil service. Instead, focus on following up politely regarding your requested written feedback. That explanation will provide concrete insight into how the panel evaluated your qualifications, leadership experience, and interview performance against the specific criteria of the role.
